production.parameters: SCHEDULE_MODE=1; all other production defaults including physical G48 and B4 unchanged
production.order: 4 adjacent spatial positions in each B4, then the next timestep; ten B4 transactions per quad
production.load: Only nonempty source-group descriptors in increasing group order, with one zero terminal descriptor for an empty context; no mandatory padding descriptors.

candidate.order: four spatial positions; each position has complete T10; original channel order 0..383
candidate.mode_authority: Frozen by the previous first-256-position same-sample calibration; current positions are outside that calibration interval but not independent-frame validation
candidate.mode_storage: one common 10-bit mode per layer; eight bank-local partial vectors
candidate.physical_bank: canonical group-row bank, not c modulo 8
candidate.last_member: Counts formed during RTL signature loading; each bank emits its accumulated contribution at its last matching source in original channel order
candidate.coefficient_reuse: One coefficient read per nonzero full-T source and output slice, then temporal scatter; no independent claim of new algebra or complete LoAS accelerator.

address_service.row_contents: 16 source channels by 96 output channels; each signed diagnostic numerator occupies a 32-bit backing word
address_service.vector: 16 output lanes, 16 contiguous 32-bit words packed down to sixteen signed INT8 numerators
address_service.logical_requests: At most one queued request per m803 logical channel, eight total; FIFO admission and service, one request accepted per cycle; each response held until ready
address_service.m803_return_channel: c modulo 8 is only the logical return lane after canonical row fetch and unpack
address_service.bank_claim: An explicit common behavioral address/service contract, not an extracted SRAM/PPA timing model
address_service.state_and_ports: One 6144-byte row buffer, eight request metadata entries, one 16-lane response holding register, one shared 128-bit fetch/extract service; no free eight-channel row read

arithmetic.stored_numerator: 9*weight in signed INT8; actual mathematical contribution is numerator/8

producer.implementation: Behavioral source DMA availability model plus actual RTL descriptor/signature loading
producer.order: timestep-major, then four positions, then channel; a timestep becomes available after each 12 cycles
producer.production_availability: May start T0 after cycle12 while subsequent timesteps arrive
producer.FTP_availability: Waits until cycle120 for the full-T signatures
producer.packing_compute_cycles: Not implemented; excluded and explicitly unresolved, distinct from the charged input transfer and RTL loading

timing.start: first modeled source transfer cycle after reset for each quad
timing.end: clock edge accepting the final downstream accumulator commit for that quad
timing.reset: Each quad starts reset and cold; reset edges excluded; all between-transaction retirement and loading edges included
timing.backpressure: bridge_ready=(cycle modulo11 !=3); commit_ready=(cycle modulo13 !=5); memory response held until acceptance
timing.report: Separate end-to-end cycles, actual RTL loading cycles, modeled source transfer, row fetch/extract activity and commits; eight quad sums, not full frame or system latency

consumer.implemented: C++ consumer verifies every (position,timestep,output channel) accumulator against independent direct integer sum; duplicate/missing commits forbidden
consumer.external_output_store: one accepted 16-lane vector per ready cycle; no modeled external writeback DMA

gates: Current production source hashes must match
Production, direct FTP and shared FTP must each match identical direct-sum outputs
Response and output payloads must remain stable under backpressure
No production or prior result writes
Any failed build/run is retained; no invented cycles
